dedupe_keys.name: nancy sns ju project fronthaul network of fixed topology usage scenario dataset 1

description: The NANCY project publishes measured time series for a fixed-topology, MEC-assisted 5G fronthaul testbed in Italy. Ten-minute video sessions use N3 and N78 bands, uplink and downlink directions, and 480p, 720p and 1080p resolutions. The deposit contains raw traffic and extracted flow-based data, with radio-front-end, server operating-system and network-function metrics; N78 experiments also record resource use. The source explicitly provides these observations as inputs for B-RAN and attack-model training and inference and for network planning and provisioning. Marco Beccari, Antonella Clavenna and Antonino Albanese deposited six ZIP archives and PDF documentation, available free from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. Individual data encodings remain unspecified. The existing NANCY latency dataset documents RTT and ping experiments, while this subject describes traffic and resource features with its own DOI and concept. A limitation is that the fixed UE and gNB laboratory arrangement limits inference about public-network mobility and congestion.
